newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela fuel price rise waits on social factors.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela fuel price rise waits on social factors.

text.p: The Venezuelan government will raise domestic gasoline prices only when the social and political circumstances are favorable, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said Thursday.
"We established a rule that the price of gasoline be raised to export price levels," Petkoff told reporters in Congress.
"But the timing and amount of the rise depends on social and political circumstances," he added.
A liter of gasoline in Venezuela currently averages about $0.11 per liter, or roughly 85 percent of its export price.

Petkoff said the government was discussing the issue with an International Monetary Fund (IMF) team currently in Caracas but stressed that a final decision on any price rise would be taken by the government.
